summary_1line: Manthara convinces Kaikeyi to exploit two old boons from Dasaratha to exile Rama for fourteen years and install Bharata as ruler.

image_candidates.scene_text: Queen Kaikeyi, furious, throws her pearl necklace to the floor and rolls upon the ground in the chamber of wrath while Manthara watches.
The hunchbacked Manthara leans close, whispering her scheme to Kaikeyi about claiming two boons to banish Rama.
Kaikeyi promises gold and ornaments to Manthara, praising her hump as the maid reclines on a white couch like a glowing flame.
